file_insights.changes_made: Added comprehensive mypy configuration section with Django plugin support

patterns_discovered.pattern: Lenient type checking configuration for existing codebase
patterns_discovered.description: All strict type checking flags (check_untyped_defs, disallow_untyped_calls, etc.) set to false, indicating a gradual typing adoption strategy
Configuration includes django_settings_module and mypy_django_plugin, showing awareness of Django's special typing requirements

patterns_discovered.pattern: Strategic exclusion of common problem directories
patterns_discovered.description: Migrations, virtual environments, and build directories explicitly excluded from type checking
Settings for show_error_codes, show_error_context, and pretty formatting optimize for readability

gotchas_discovered.explanation: While other warnings are enabled, this setting allows functions returning any type without warning, which could mask type issues
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider enabling once codebase is better typed

gotchas_discovered.explanation: Permits variable redefinition which can hide logical errors and is generally discouraged in strict type checking
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Review and set to false once codebase patterns are standardized

gotchas_discovered.explanation: Allows implicit re-exports which can create hidden API surface and complicate module contracts
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider setting to false for better API clarity

approach_outcome.description: Successfully created a well-structured mypy configuration that balances type safety with practical integration into an existing Django codebase
approach_outcome.strategy_used: Gradual typing adoption with lenient initial settings, allowing for phased strictness increases as codebase is typed
approach_outcome.completion_evidence: Single successful attempt with comprehensive configuration covering Python version, Django integration, exclusions, warnings, and error display options

recommendations.recommendation: Establish a roadmap to gradually enable stricter type checking flags (check_untyped_defs, disallow_untyped_defs) in phases as codebase typing improves
recommendations.rationale: Current lenient configuration is appropriate for onboarding but should not be permanent; stricter checking catches more issues

recommendations.recommendation: Enable warn_return_any and review functions returning Any type before enabling
recommendations.rationale: This setting helps identify type annotation gaps that could mask runtime errors

recommendations.recommendation: Set allow_redefinition to false after standardizing variable naming and binding patterns
recommendations.rationale: Prevents accidental variable shadowing and improves code clarity

recommendations.recommendation: Document the gradual typing adoption strategy and communicate timeline to development team
recommendations.rationale: Ensures consistency in how new code is typed and aligns team expectations

recommendations.recommendation: Add mypy to CI/CD pipeline with exclusion of warnings to start, building toward strict enforcement
recommendations.rationale: Automated type checking prevents regression and enforces consistent standards
